 Tahiti vs Cook Islands Preview & Prediction | 2026 International Friendly
 by Alex Lawes · 16 November 2026 at 11:06 am 
 Post 
 Share 
 Click here for today’s sports betting tips from our expert analysts! 
 For the second time in this international break and the fourth time this autumn, Tahiti and the Cook Islands face off in an international friendly. 
 Kick-off date/time: 
 17 November 2026 at 5:30 am 
 How to watch on TV & online:  UK – Not televised & cannot be streamed / USA – Not televised & cannot be streamed
 Tahiti vs Cook Islands prediction 
 In the first couple of friendlies between these two sides, Tahiti managed a 3-1 victory before the Cook Islands won by three goals to two a few days later. Then, the other day, Tahiti hammered the Cook Islands with a dominant 4-0 victory.
 The Tahitians hadn’t played since March 2025 when they lost to New Caledonia in the third round of OFC qualification for FIFA World Cup 2026, while Cook Islands themselves hadn’t played since a friendly lost to American Samoa in September 2024.
 Cook Islands were competitive last month but Tahiti have now shown twice that they can run up a score against them and that should repeat here.
 Tahiti vs Cook Islands tip:  Tahiti to score two or more goals
